app.title: Live Suspects
app.tagline: Interrogate the suspects. Find the killer.

lobby.title: Waiting room
lobby.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start…
lobby.rules: Take turns asking the suspects questions. Your team shares {{moves}} questions. When you are ready, call a vote and name the killer.

generating.title: Preparing the case…
generating.hint: The crime scene is being staged. This can take up to a minute.

inv.yourTurn: Your turn: pick a suspect and ask a question.

system.SUSPECT_SILENT: The suspect stays silent… The question was not counted. Try again.
system.VOTE_TIED: The vote is tied. The investigation continues.
system.FORCED_VOTE: No questions left. Time to name the killer.

vote.title: Who is the killer?
vote.forced: You are out of questions. You must decide now.

reveal.correct: Case closed! You caught the killer.
reveal.wrong: Wrong suspect. The killer walks free.
reveal.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start a new case…

errors.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: That room does not exist (or it has expired).
errors.NOT_IN_ROOM: You are not in a room.
errors.UNKNOWN_PLAYER: You are not part of this room.
errors.NOT_HOST: Only the host can do that.
errors.WRONG_PHASE: You can't do that right now.
errors.ANSWER_IN_PROGRESS: Wait for the suspect to finish answering.
